title: When the Atlas Sings
author: Wendell Ashgrove
blurb: Coral Okafor, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
